item.title: Virat Kohli, Rohit Sharma demoted to 'Grade B' in BCCI's central contract list for 2025-26 season
item.description: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) on Monday (February 9) announced the Annual Player Contracts for Team India Senior Men and Senior Women for the 2025-26 season (October 1st, 2025 to September 30th, 2026). The BCCI Central Contracts are divided into three categories – Grade A, Grade B and Grade C. Grade A+ category has been abolished for the 2025-26 season. In a major development, Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma, who remain active only in the ODI format, have been demoted to Grade B.

item.title: “Some jaundiced people see”: Gavaskar counters Nasser Hussain’s ‘bully’ claim while referencing Sooryavanshi’s brutal 175
item.description: Not the one to mince his words, legendary batter Sunil Gavaskar took a dig at former England skipper Nasser Hussain for his recent comments on the ICC-PCB row. item.title: IPL: RCB and RR franchises set for sale with Manchester United owner in shortlisted buyers’ list- Report
item.description: With a number of international investors putting up billion-dollar offers for the Bengaluru-based Indian Premier League (IPL) team Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB), its ownership may be about to change. item.description: Great Indian opener Sunil Gavaskar has made a huge dig at Pakistan and PCB chief Mohsin Naqvi for the touted boycott of their T20 World Cup 2026 match against India.
